source_note: v0.20.11 is a narrow hotfix based on the published v0.20.10 Marketplace payload. The Codex UserPromptSubmit command now uses a source-level adapter that nests additionalContext under hookSpecificOutput; the adapter fix is in Craft source commit d8c7be917f6280855b394129b87c08dbc243d564. All other plugin payload files are inherited unchanged from v0.20.10. source_tree_digest is the deterministic digest of the resulting Craft Context payload; this release does not attest a full rebuild.
